主要内容: On March 10, 2014, Tucson Electric Power Company, a subsidiary of UNS Energy Corporation, issued and sold $150 million aggregate principal amount of its 5.00% Notes due 2044. The company plans to use the net proceeds from the sale to repay approximately $90 million on its revolving credit facility, with the remaining funds allocated to general corporate purposes. The Notes were registered under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, under Registration Statement No. 333-181305-01. This filing includes exhibits such as the Officer’s Certificate establishing the terms of the Notes and legal opinions regarding their validity. The filing was signed by Kevin P. Larson, Senior Vice President and Principal Financial Officer of both companies.
